metadata.description: Part category performance investigating pricing and availability issues

turns.content: Our inventory team noticed discrepancies in part pricing. Can you investigate part pricing patterns?

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should propose analyzing part pricing data

turns.content: What part-related tables and columns do we have?

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should show PART and PARTSUPP schema

turns.content: Show me the distribution of parts by type.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should show count by P_TYPE

turns.content: For pricing analysis, always compare retail price (P_RETAILPRICE) with supply cost (PS_SUPPLYCOST).

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should use these columns for price comparison

turns.content: Which part types have the highest markup (retail price vs supply cost)?

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should calculate markup percentage by P_TYPE

turns.content: Let me see the parts with the lowest markup. These might be pricing errors.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should show parts with lowest or negative markup

turns.content: Only include parts that have been ordered at least once.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should filter parts that appear in LINEITEM

turns.content: Show me suppliers for these low-markup parts.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should show suppliers for low-markup parts

turns.content: Are there multiple suppliers for these parts? If so, compare their prices.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should show price variation across suppliers for same parts

turns.content: Some suppliers charge significantly more. Use L_EXTENDEDPRICE for actual sold prices.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should use extended price for actual transaction analysis

turns.content: Compare the actual sold prices to the retail prices for these parts.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should compare L_EXTENDEDPRICE to P_RETAILPRICE

turns.content: Are we selling below retail for some parts?

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should identify parts sold below retail

turns.content: Remember the markup analysis we did? Can you recalculate using actual sold prices instead of supply cost?

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should recalculate markup using L_EXTENDEDPRICE

turns.content: Exclude parts with container 'SM CASE' — those have special pricing rules.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should filter out P_CONTAINER = 'SM CASE'

turns.content: Show me the profit margin by part type now.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should calculate profit margin by P_TYPE

turns.content: Which part brands have the worst margins?

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should show margins by P_BRAND

turns.content: Let me check availability. Show me parts with low availability (PS_AVAILQTY).

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should identify low-stock parts

turns.content: Are the low-availability parts also the low-margin ones?

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should correlate availability with margin

turns.content: What was the average markup we calculated earlier?

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should recall the markup figure

turns.content: Show me order frequency for these problematic parts.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should show order counts for low-margin parts

turns.content: Low-margin parts are ordered frequently. Let me see the revenue impact.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should calculate revenue for low-margin parts

turns.content: Which suppliers are providing these low-margin high-volume parts?

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should identify suppliers for problematic parts

turns.content: Are these suppliers also providing high-margin parts?

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should compare supplier product portfolios

turns.content: Apply all our filters and show me a pricing summary by part type.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should apply: ordered parts only, exclude SM CASE, use L_EXTENDEDPRICE

turns.content: Let me see which sizes are most problematic.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should analyze by P_SIZE

turns.content: Create a chart showing margin distribution by part type.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should create visualization

turns.content: What filters are active in our analysis?

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should list all established filters

turns.content: Show me the top 20 parts by order count with all filters applied.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should show parts ranking with filters

turns.content: Are there seasonal patterns in part ordering?

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should show monthly order patterns

turns.content: Do part prices vary by season?

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should analyze price changes over time

turns.content: Let me see the price variance for each part type.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should show price variance by P_TYPE

turns.content: Which manufacturers have price consistency issues?

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should identify MFGRs with high price variance

turns.content: Earlier we looked at low-markup parts. What part types were those?

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should recall the part types identified

turns.content: Show me a final summary of pricing issues by part type and brand.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should provide comprehensive summary

turns.content: Create a chart showing price distribution for top 5 part types.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should create visualization

turns.content: What's the total revenue impact of pricing inconsistencies?

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should calculate total revenue at risk

turns.content: Show me alternative suppliers for the problematic parts.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should identify alternative suppliers in PARTSUPP

turns.content: Compare pricing from alternative vs current suppliers.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should show price comparison

turns.content: What are the top 3 pricing recommendations based on this analysis?

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should provide recommendations

turns.content: Thank you. We've identified that certain part types have inconsistent pricing, with some being sold below retail, and specific suppliers charging significantly more than others for the same parts.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should acknowledge and confirm findings

persistedCorrections.correctionText: Compare P_RETAILPRICE vs PS_SUPPLYCOST for pricing
persistedCorrections.description: Use retail price and supply cost for price comparison
Filter parts that appear in LINEITEM
Use extended price for actual transaction prices

anaphoricReferences.expectedResolution: Markup by part type from turn 5
Ordered parts, exclude SM CASE, use L_EXTENDEDPRICE
